method: xpts.json rank + league.json template flags as EO proxy; WebSearch cross-check of overall ownership/captaincy polls (Haaland ~72% owned, ~55% captain share GW5). Elite (top-10k) EO estimated as overall +10-20% on nailed premiums, -30-50% on price-driven budget picks.

template_core.note: Overall 72% owned, ~55-60% captain share vs SUN (H). EO well over 100% — the single largest EO block in the game this GW.
Top xPts in the entire pool (10.32). Premium City defender vs SUN (FDR 2). Biggest non-owned template hole.
Confirmed ~26% ownership pre-season and rising. City attacker vs SUN. Owned by most rivals; xPts only 3.79 so damage is capped.
12.0m premium, second in captaincy metrics (CRF 11). Moderate EO leak, xPts 5.74.
Owned. Captained here at ~2% field captain share — see captain_shield.
League-flagged template. DOUBTFUL 75%, xPts 2.70. High EO means a blank is shared pain, not rank damage — but he is our VICE, which is the real problem.

captain_shield.floor: HIGH — nailed 90min penalty-taking striker, 4 goals in last 3, MCI at home vs SUN (SUN carry FDR 5 this GW, i.e. worst matchup in the pool)
captain_shield.why: MUST-NOT-MISS. ~58% of the field has the armband on him. If he hauls 15+, every manager who captained elsewhere loses ~8-10 net points to the field in one stroke. The 25/26 backtest lesson is explicit: fading the template captain cost points. He is also the highest captain_xpts of any nailed attacker in xpts.json.
captain_shield.directive: DO NOT FADE. sim-lab / the-gaffer: Haaland is the default armband unless a confirmed lineup absence lands. Any alternative must clear him on cum_pts AND xPts, not on 'differential' reasoning.

differentials.why: 3rd-highest xPts in the pool at 4.5m and effectively unowned. Attacking full-back — CS + attacking return double-up is the ceiling path. Best pure rank-gain punt available.

Everton defence is on FDR 2 and owns four of the top-14 xPts slots (Tarkowski 8.17, Mykolenko 6.83, Maitland-Niles 6.44, Branthwaite 6.17). The field is not on Everton. Cheapest route into that block.
Highest-xPts EVE defender, set-piece aerial goal threat on top of the clean-sheet base. Sub-8% EO with a top-5 projection is the definition of a rank-gain asset.

Took 24% of a GW5 captaincy poll — he is the field's designated Haaland alternative, so he is a semi-differential with real captain-day upside. Highest-ceiling mid outside the premiums. NOTE: at 16% EO he is not cheap rank insurance; own-but-don't-captain is the correct posture.
NFO on FDR 2. Borderline differential (just over the 8% line) with a goal-threat profile from set pieces.
2nd-highest xPts in the pool. Cheaper and much lower-owned route into the City clean sheet than Gvardiol — a way to close the City gap without buying the template.

rank_risks.detail: Captain Palmer + Vice João Pedro (DOUBTFUL, 75% chance, xPts 2.70). If Palmer is a late absentee the armband falls to a player who may also not start — worst case the captaincy evaporates to 0 doubled while ~58% of the field doubles Haaland.
rank_risks.action: Move VICE to Haaland immediately. This is free insurance and costs nothing if Palmer plays.

rank_risks.detail: Captaining Palmer (captain_xpts 10.26, ~2% field capt share) instead of Haaland (captain_xpts 14.90, ~58% field capt share) is a -56% effective-ownership short on the most-captained asset in the game, against a home fixture vs the worst-rated opponent in the pool. Expected cost vs field ≈ -4.6 xPts; tail cost on a Haaland brace/hattrick ≈ -10 to -18 rank-adjusted points.
rank_risks.action: Per APEX protocol this is not a 'fade the template' call to make. Unless Palmer is the season cum_pts leader by a clear margin AND Haaland has a confirmed fitness flag, hand the armband to Haaland. Backtest evidence: avoiding high-EO captains cost points.

rank_risks.detail: MCI occupy 4 of the top 8 xPts slots vs SUN (FDR 2 / SUN FDR 5) and the squad holds exactly one City asset (Haaland). Rivals doubling or tripling up on the City defence will bank a shared clean sheet the squad does not have.
rank_risks.action: market-desk: one City defender (Guéhi 6.0 at ~14% EO preferred over Gvardiol 5.7 at ~34% EO on differential grounds; Gvardiol preferred on raw xPts 10.32) is the highest-value single transfer this GW. Bank is 0.7m — funding likely requires a downgrade.

rank_risks.detail: Three starters project under 3.2 xPts: Ajer 3.10 (BRE, FDR 4), Wissa 2.85 (NEW), João Pedro 2.70 (CHE, DOUBTFUL). Egan (5.37) and Gakpo (4.96) are on the bench above two of them.
rank_risks.action: Swap Egan in for Ajer at minimum. If João Pedro is not cleared by the Friday presser, bench him for Gakpo — the Rotation-Risk/availability gate covers this.

rank_risks.detail: Both league-flagged template players are owned. A blank from either is absorbed by the field and does not move rank. No defensive action required on ownership grounds — only on availability grounds.

BB, WC and TC already spent by GW4; only FH and one WC remain. No chip lever available to rescue a bad GW5 — makes the vice-captain and availability fixes above more important than usual, since there is no safety net.

eo_summary.net_eo_position: Roughly template-neutral on assets, but SHORT ~56% EO on the captaincy and SHORT the City defensive block. Captaincy is the dominant term — fix that first.
